exercises.title: Impact 1 — the questions to ask
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers gives a checklist of questions for impact analysis: Does the change conflict with existing requirements? Does it affect performance or other quality requirements? Is it technically feasible? Does it need more resources (people, hardware, licences)? Which other requirements, designs, code, tests, help screens, documents and user training are affected? What is the effect on schedule and cost? What happens if we do NOT make it?

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Checklist câu hỏi phân tích ảnh hưởng của Wiegers.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Impact 2 — affected or not?
exercises.problemHtml:
Change request CR-14 (PetCare): "Allow cancelling up to 4 hours before the appointment instead of 2." For each work product, decide whether it is affected.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Impact 3 — find everything a change touches
exercises.problemHtml:
Trace links are stored as pairs [from, to] meaning "to depends on from" (a change to from may require a change to to). Write function impacted(links, changed) returning the sorted list of every item reachable from changed (an id or an array of ids) by following links, not including the changed items themselves. Handle cycles. Then write function effort(items, hours) that sums hours[prefix] for each item, where the prefix is the text before the first "-" (e.g. "TC-31" ⇒ "TC"); unknown prefixes count 1 hour.

Requirements

  • impacted(LINKS, "BR-07") on the sample gives FR-21, FR-22, HELP-04, MSG-E12, TC-31, TC-32, TC-33, UC-05.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Liên kết lưu dạng cặp [from, to]: "to phụ thuộc from". Viết impacted(links, changed) trả danh sách đã sắp xếp mọi mục tới được từ changed (một id hoặc mảng id) theo liên kết, KHÔNG gồm chính các mục bị đổi; xử lý chu trình. Rồi viết effort(items, hours) cộng hours[tiền tố] cho từng mục (tiền tố là phần trước dấu "-" đầu tiên); tiền tố lạ tính 1 giờ.

Yêu cầu

  • Với dữ liệu mẫu, impacted(LINKS, "BR-07") cho 8 mục như trên.

Dùng Object.create(null) hoặc hasOwnProperty cho bảng tra (id "toString", "constructor").
